task: Distinguish simulated proton-proton collision events in which a Higgs boson is produced (signal) from background events.
dataset_description: 21 low-level detector features: transverse momentum (pT), pseudorapidity (eta) and azimuth (phi) of one lepton and four jets, each jet's b-tag, and the missing transverse energy's magnitude and azimuth; and 7 high-level invariant masses physicists derive from them (m_jj, m_jjj, m_lv, m_jlv, m_bb, m_wbb, m_wwbb).
